title: Greek Skillet Tofu
description: A simple and flavorful vegetarian dish made with crispy tofu, crunchy vegetables, and a hint of Mediterranean spices.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and bell pepper and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomato and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Crumble the tofu into small pieces and add it to the skillet. Cook until the tofu is golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Season with salt, pepper, dried oregano, and garlic powder.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
